title: Prism fact schema v0
description: T1-oriented fact shapes. Semantic (T3/T4) layers are separate artifacts — do not encode CPG here.
breaking_change_policy: Major version bump in schemas/ and prism-ir::FACT_SCHEMA_VERSION. Additive node/edge kinds and confidence values are non-breaking and do not bump major.

confidence_notes.asserted: P12 Stage A: documentation claims it but code does not prove it; never satisfies a precision gate.

doc_layer: P12 Stage A (additive): markdown files become Doc nodes; ATX headings become Section nodes (id section:{path}#{slug}). CONTAINS builds the heading hierarchy; REFERENCES captures relative links and intra-doc anchors; MENTIONS captures inline-code identifiers as doc→code claims (dst unresolved:{name}, confidence asserted) bound to real symbols in Stage B.
unresolved_policy: CALLS that cannot be same-file resolved use dst id unresolved:{name} with confidence heuristic; never silently drop. Doc MENTIONS use the same unresolved:{name} target with confidence asserted.
id_policy: Prefer readable deterministic syntactic IDs (SCIP-compatible where possible). Avoid opaque integer-only IDs.

ir_layers.L0: Raw bytes / paths — P0 populates via fingerprint
